summary: Cliconf plugins moved to collections on Galaxy and are included with pip installs of Ansible 2.10+. List them with ansible-doc -t cliconf -l and view details with ansible-doc -t cliconf <name>.
questions: Where did the cliconf plugins go in newer Ansible versions?
How do I list available cliconf plugins?
Do I get cliconf plugins when installing Ansible with pip?

answer_card.title: Viewing cliconf plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
Cliconf plugins now live in collections on Ansible Galaxy. A pip install of Ansible 2.10 or later includes several.

```shell
ansible-doc -t cliconf -l
ansible-doc -t cliconf <plugin name>
```
